description: This Java class 'DrugEditor' extends 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' to handle serialization/deserialization of 'Drug' objects, facilitating their transfer between forms and backend within the OpenMRS system. It provides methods to retrieve 'Drug' objects by ID and UUID via the Context's ConceptService.

classes.name: DrugEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for 'Drug' objects used in Spring form binding, capable of retrieving Drug instances by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Drug object by its integer ID using the Context's ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Drug object by its UUID string using the Context's ConceptService.
